title: Italia Dance Music Radio - Concrete Confetti

lines.l: I kept your name on the screen For too many seasons
A folded note in my jeans With the same bad reason
The keys in the dish by the door Still clink like they mean it
I said I was over it before, but I never cleaned it
And every little corner knows what we did there
Every little shadow still has your shape in the air
The past, the past keeps my hand on the line
On the past, the past, I understand why you won't let go
I can laugh, I can leave, but it follows me home
The past, the past, the past won't turn to stone
I found a blue cafe receipt In an old coat pocket
One chipmunk, two berm seats And I still wanna stop it
You're laughing in the back of my head Like a song I don't know
I moved every box from the bed, but not what you stole
And every little corner, knows what we did there
Every little shadow, still has your shape in the air
The past, the past, it keeps my hand on the lock, on the lock
The past, the past, I understand why it won't let go
I can last, I can leave, but it follows me home
The past, the past, the past won't turn to stone
Maybe time is a long road, not a door you can slam
Maybe I don't need the old ghost to know who I am
So I set down the box now, let it fly where it fell
If the past wants my heart back, it can keep the shell
The past, the past that keeps my hand on the lock, on the lock
The past, the past, I understand why you won't let go
I can laugh, I can leave, but it follows me home
The past, the past, the past won't turn to stone
